milestones.title: Phase 1 — Destination Contract
milestones.description: Make country and destination explicit across the API, trip persistence, traveler UI, prompts, chat edits, and guest sync. Preserve existing Kyrgyzstan trips and clients.

milestones.title: Phase 2 — Country-aware Data and Partners
milestones.description: Make place enrichment, routing, sponsored matching, business location entry, and moderation country-aware. Keep Kyrgyzstan as the compatibility baseline.

milestones.title: Phase 3 — Itinerary Quality and Trust
milestones.description: Improve detailed day plans and route feasibility; expose provenance, attribution, and degraded provider behavior. Review rights before importing data.

milestones.title: Phase 4 — Offers and International Scale
milestones.description: Add read-only flight and accommodation offers and expand partner markets only after confirming provider access, economics, and operational readiness.
